  PROBLEM: The default module list contains `hardhat` and `ethers`, which are not importable Python modules.

- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-hardhat-solidity/tests/20_import_audit.sh.j2:10-12 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The test script unconditionally invokes `python3` even though the node-hardhat-solidity image does not install Python.
  WHY: The Docker image includes foundry and basic utilities but not `python3`, so the script will abort with `command not found`.
- scripts/validation_lint.py:609-613 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash, google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: `_check_test_script_prologue` accepts `set -euo pipefail` anywhere in the file instead of near the top.
  WHY: This lets scripts pass lint even when earlier commands run without strict-mode protection, weakening the prologue check; reviewers disagreed only on whether this is a bug, not on the behavior.
- scripts/validation_lint.py:44 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The strict-mode regex is used in a way that may miss valid same-line shell constructs in some cases.
  WHY: The reviewer warned that relying on line-by-line `match()` is fragile for multi-command lines; this was a secondary concern rather than the main prologue issue.
